Regular Meeting of the Committee for Rent Reduction and
Exemption of the Public Bodies in French Concession.

The standing committee of this organization met at
3 p.m., day before yesterday for the second time. Nine members
attended the meeting which was presided by Mr. Chu Chen-hua
( 瞿振華 ). The following matters were discussed:-
(1) The Chairman reported regarding the resolutions of
the last meeting.
(2) The drafting committee submitted the constitution of
11 articles with 5 bye-laws and constitution for branch orga-
nizations of 12 articles. After discussion, article by article
they were passed to be printed.
(3) Election of divisional directors - the following 9
were elected: Mr. Yui Tze-ch'eng (於子承), general affairs,
Mr. Sheng Chih-jen ( 盛植人 ), finance; Mr. Mao Teh-jun
( 毛德潤 ) Miscellaneous affairs, Mr. Liu Yun-sheng ( 劉韻生 )
committee matters, Mr. Yeh Jui-chai ( 葉瑞齋 ) investigation,
Mr. Li Ming ( 李銘 ) arbitration, Mr. Chang Pin-ch'iu ( 張彬秋 )
organization, Mr. Hsu Tzu-hsien ( 徐子賢 ) guidance, Mr. Chu
Chen-hua, social matters.
(4) Refinance of the organization, a resolution was
passed that the money be advanced by the commercial unions.
The French Concession Commercial union contributes $20.00,
Nanyang-Chiao, $10.00, West District $10.00, Tang Kia Wan $10.
Other organizations are to be approached for contributions.
(5) Re public declaration and posters of this organiza-
tion. These were passed to be sent to print.
(6) Mr. Ho Hsiao-huan ( 賀寰 ) of A-1 Tun-jen Terrace
( 敦仁里 ) Rue Brenier de Montmorand, asked for help: Resolved
that (1) the land-lord is to be warned, and (2) a letter be
addressed to the counsel of the landlord to advise the latter
to cease oppressive measures in view of the present conditions.

same road, asked help: It was considered that the matter
involved legal points and it was decided to forward the matter

division.

reduce the rentals for premises in the Settlement. This being so,
it is not in a position to force either landlords or tenants to
comply with its proposals. In the event of a landlord insisting
upon collecting the full amount of rent due, the Committee has no
redress but will resort to petitioning the Courts should civil
action be commenced against a tenant, asking the Court to consider
the financial straits of the Shanghai public and render a decision
in favour of the tenant. Letters in this strain have already
been sent to the various Chinese Courts in Shanghai by the Com-
mittee.
Propaganda matter opposing such an action on the part of
local landlords may also be prepared for the local press.
Should a tenant decide that the period of time set by the
Committee for the exemption of rentals or the amount of reduction
of rentals is not sufficient, the Committee will stand aloof.
While no definite decisions have been reached as to the period
of time for which the collection of rentals will be exempted, the
Committees have tentatively decided to advocate the suspension of
the collection of rentals for three months in those districts in
the Settlement north of the Soochow Creek and for two months in
those districts in the Settlement south of the Creek. These
proposals will be submitted to a general meeting of representatives
of local bodies which the Committee hopes to convene in the near
future. The exact date and venue of this meeting are as yet un-
decided.
The Committee is governed by no rules but professes to be a
public spirited body anxious to relieve what it considers to be
the impoverished condition of Settlement residents. While un-
doubtedly having the support of persons who are likely to benefit
from any reduction in rent, the Committee does not appear to be
to any degree representative of either the landlords or the
tenants.
So far the activities of the Committee have been of a nature

若租户认为委员会设定的免租期或减租幅度不足，委员会将不予介入。虽然对于免收租金的期限尚未作出明确决定，但委员会已初步决定，主张在苏州河以北的租界地区暂停收租三个月，在苏州河以南的租界地区暂停收租两个月。这些提议将提交给由地方团体代表组成的全体会议审议，委员会希望于近期召开此次会议。会议的确切日期和地点尚未确定。

REPORT TO THE PROPERTY OWNERS' ASSOCIATION
REGARDING THE ACTUAL SITUATION ON GENERAL
RENT REDUCTION IN THE CONCESSIONS AND WATER
SUPPLY IN THE SETTLEMENT.
------------------

The difficulties faced by the Property Owners are of two
kinds, and they are put in such a position that should the actual
situation be maintained the only solution left to them would be
to close up their cities; at least cities occupied by working
classes

a/ Loss of their income on account of rent reduction,
b/ Increase of their expenses owing to the new water
charges in the Settlement.

1. REDUCTION OF RENTS:

You are certainly aware of the campaign started in the local
press on this subject, claiming, besides immediate suppression of
2 months rent, nothing less than 50% of reduction of the actual
rent.

Already, owing to the suppression of two months' rent for
the properties situated in the districts affected by the hostilities
many among us have abandoned voluntarily 1/6 of our annual income.

The Property Owners did not hesitate to grant this request
which was justified, in spite of the losses they will have to bear.

But, taking advantage of the preceding facts, the movement
has widened to the regions non-affected by the hostilities, and the
tenants, who not only did not suffer from any trouble, but have
often benefited in sub-letting their premises to the refugees, are
now forming "Associations" (?) for the suppression and reduction
of rents.

I beg to submit you a letter received on 14th April 1932, which
shows the eminence of danger. It reads as follows:

"Mr. Darre, "13th April 1932"

"The Chinese tenants of this city have entered into
"Association, and joined the French Concession Committee for
"reduction of rentals.
"It has been published by the Nanking Government (x)
"that rents will be decreased by 50%, as from February, owing to
"the financial difficulties, during recent troubles.
"We hereby kindly request you to discontinue the
"collection of rents, according to the above publication.
"As soon as a decision is reached, by the "Reduction of
"rental Committee" we will collectively pay our rents."

This letter, as you see, is addressed by the tenants of a
pages.zh:
上海房地产主协会

會公主業產房海上
秘书：A. W. BUCK，
金神路28号

C C F Y 19/4/32 上海，........................................ 19

致房地产主协会关于租界普遍减租及公共租界供水实际情况的报告。
------------------

房地产主面临的困难有两种，他们所处的境地是，如果维持现状，留给他们的唯一解决办法就是关闭其房产；至少是那些由工人阶级居住的房产

a/ 因减租而导致的收入损失，
b/ 因公共租界新的水费而导致的支出增加。

1. 减租：

你们肯定知晓本地报刊上就此话题发起的运动，除了立即免除2个月租金外，还要求实际租金减少不少于50%。

由于位于受战事影响地区的房产已免除两个月租金，我们中的许多人已自愿放弃了年收入的六分之一。

尽管房地产主将承受损失，但他们毫不犹豫地批准了这一正当要求。

但是，利用前述事实，该运动已扩大到未受战事影响的地区，那些不仅未遭受任何困扰，反而经常通过将房屋转租给难民而获利的租户，现在正组建“协会”（？）以要求免除和减少租金。

谨向你们提交一封于1932年4月14日收到的信件，该信显示了危险的严重性。内容如下：

“Darre先生，”1932年4月13日“

“本房产的中国租户已结成
“协会，并加入了法租界减租委员会。
“南京政府(x)已公布，鉴于近期的
“动荡造成的财政困难，自二月起
“租金将减少50%。
“据此公告，我们恳请你们停止
“收取租金。
“一旦‘减租委员会’作出决定，
“我们将集体支付租金。”

如你所见，这封信是由一处位于

property situated in French Concession, out of the affected zone.

I do not wish to comment upon this letter. It shows
sufficiently the actual spirit of the tenants.

(x) I would state that the publicity mentioned in this case
probably concerns the town of Nanking only.

On the other hand, on 9th April, the French Consul General
received a letter concerning the rent reduction and requesting
him to "confirm" a certain ordinance of 1921, ordinance which
aimed to prevent the Property Owners from increasing the rentals,
arbitrarily, out of proportion with the Property Owners'
justified charges.

This study was on the loss of income, now remains the point
of increase of Property Owners' charges, owing to the increase
of water rate, in the Settlement.

11. INCREASE OF WATER CHARGES:

The Shanghai Waterworks are putting through their plans,
unfortunately accepted by the authorities, to charge water
consumption by meter.

What would be such increase ?

In order to give you an idea, I may tell you that in one
of my cities where I am paying monthly at the actual rate of 7.5%
on rentals, i.e., Dcl. 55.00, I will have to pay, as per a written
declaration courteously given by the Shanghai Waterworks themselves,
based on the average monthly consumption from June to December 1932,
the sum of Dol. 290.00, i.e., 5 times as much.

The charges, paid by the Property Owners, relative to the
water supply only, will be brought, owing to the above fact, from
7.5% on rentals to 37.5%. The average figure usually admitted
for the exploiting of a city, or for general expenses besides
water supply is 16% on rentals.

This figure of 16% included the water supply at 8% until 1931,
and at 7.5% during 1931, thus leaving 8.5%. The balance of 8.5%
added to 37.5% will bring the total for general expenses to the
abnormal figure of 46%.

After this, the same statement of the Waterworks adds:

"... As soon as the tenants find that they must pay, though
"indirectly, for water wasted, they will undoubtedly exercise more
"care."

But, what are the means to make tenants pay water consumption?
By individual water meters?

They will refuse as their contracts, at actual rent, include
the water supply.

By increase of rentals?

金神路28号

法租界、不在受影响区域内的房产的租户寄出的。

我不愿对此信发表评论。它充分显示了租户当前的态度。

(x) 我想说明，此处提到的公告可能仅涉及南京城。

另一方面，4月9日，法国总领事收到了一封关于减租的信函，请求他“确认”一项1921年的法令，该法令旨在防止房地产主在与房地产主的合理费用不成比例的情况下任意提高租金。

上述研究涉及收入损失，现在剩下的一点是，由于公共租界水费上涨，房地产主的费用增加。

11. 水费增加：

上海自来水公司正在推行其计划，不幸的是该计划已获当局接受，即按水表计量收取水费。

这种增加会有多大？

为了让你有个概念，我可以告诉你，在我的一处房产中，我目前按月支付租金的7.5%作为水费，即55.00美元，根据上海自来水公司客气地提供的书面声明，基于1932年6月至12月的平均月用水量，我将不得不支付290.00美元，即原来的5倍。

鉴于上述事实，房地产主支付的仅与供水相关的费用将从租金的7.5%提高到37.5%。通常公认的用于经营房产或除供水外的一般费用的平均数字为租金的16%。

这个16%的数字包括1931年之前8%的水费和1931年期间的7.5%的水费，从而留下8.5%。将这8.5%的余额加上37.5%，将使一般费用总额达到46%这一异常数字。

此后，自来水公司的同一份声明补充道：

“...一旦租户发现他们必须为浪费的水付费，尽管
“是间接付费，他们无疑会更加小心。”

但是，让租户支付水费的手段是什么？
通过安装独立水表？

他们会拒绝，因为他们按现行租金签订的合同包括供水服务。

通过提高租金？

Which Property Owner would dare to propose such an
increase, when we are debating the tenants' requests for
reduction of rents by 50% ?

I wish to point out also, the draconian measures that
the Waterworks have adopted, in order to prevent the
construction of artesian wells: minimum fee and double rates
(Ref. Parag. 4 of Schedule C)

IN CONCLUSION, it seems that regarding the water charges,
which one cannot think to increase at present, one has to obtain
from the Shanghai Waterworks that the latter should postpone the
application of the new tariff for water supply on meter basis,
until the conditions become normal.

This tariff, should it be paid by the working classes of
tenants, as it has been supposed, would almost prevent the latter
to consume water, thus causing considerable prejudice to
public health.

The postponement would also have the advantage to leave to
the Waterworks the possibility to reconsider the new tariff in
order to cooperate with the Property Owner in the development
of suburbs of the Settlement, where the latter is trying to do
his best to give to the working classes, the maximum welfare which
the tenants' very low wages cannot afford.

In fact, it would be preferable, and I leave it to the
General Committee to make a suggestion to the Shanghai Waterworks,
in case they are of my opinion, to maintain the fixed rate of 7.5%
for the Cities with low rentals, intended for the working classes.

On the other hand, regarding the reduction of rentals it
would be most desirable to obtain the assistance of the authorities.

The ordinance issued in 1921, by the French Consul General
and mentioned recently in the request of the tenants to the
French Consul General shows the usefulness of such ordinance.

One should request the authorities of the International
Settlement as well as of the French Concession, to issue rules
showing the danger of such "Associations" and specifying to the
tenants that they are in no way authorized, especially in group,
to suspend or to suppress the payment of their rents, which are
due in accordance with their contracts, as long as a definite
agreement with their Landlord is not reached.

Those are, in brief, the dangers which nowadays threaten the
Property Owner. Owing to them, his running average expenses
would be raised from 16% to 46%, and his income reduced by 50%,
bringing his loss to 96%.

Being thus unable to live upon his income, the Property Owner
would be compelled to live upon his capital.

This state of things would rapidly involve the ruin of
Realty Estate, and concurrently a stop in the development of the
Concessions, giving rise to a situation far more critical; that
is, unemployment for labourers.

在我们正就租户要求减租 50% 进行辩论之际，哪位房地产主敢提出这样的增幅？

我还想指出，自来水厂为防止开凿自流井而采取的严厉措施：最低收费及加倍费率（参见附表 C 第 4 段）。

总之，关于目前看来不宜增加的水费，必须从上海自来水厂方面获得承诺，即推迟实施新的按表计量供水费率，直至局势恢复正常。

如果如所推测的那样，该费率由工人阶级租户支付，将几乎导致他们无法用水，从而对公共卫生造成相当大的损害。

推迟实施还具有一个优势，即让自来水厂有机会重新考虑新费率，以便与房地产主合作，促进租界郊区的发展；在那里，房地产主正尽力为工人阶级提供其微薄的工资所难以负担的最大福利。

事实上，更可取的做法是维持针对低租金城市、面向工人阶级的 7.5% 固定费率。我将此留给总委员会向上海自来水厂提出建议，假如他们赞同我的观点的话。

另一方面，关于减租问题，最理想的是获得当局的协助。

法国总领事于 1921 年颁布的法令，以及最近在租户致法国总领事的请愿书中提到的该法令，显示了此类法令的效用。

应当请求国际租界当局以及法租界当局发布规章，阐明此类“协会”的危险性，并明确告知租户，除非与房东达成明确协议，否则他们无权，特别是以集体形式，暂停或拒付根据合同应缴的租金。

简而言之，这些就是当今威胁房地产主的危险。由于这些危险，其日常平均开支将从 16% 上升至 46%，收入减少 50%，导致其亏损达到 96%。

因此，房地产主将无法依靠收入维持生活，而被迫动用本金。

这种状况将迅速导致房地产业的破产，并同时使租界的发展停滞，引发更为严峻的局面，即劳工失业。

C O F Y 18/4/32

AGITATION FOR RENT REDUCTION

The attention of the Chairman of the Shanghai Property
Owners' Association is respectfully called to the refractory
attitude of tenants in the Hongkew District, where, in spite
of the sympathetic remission of their rent for February and
March, rents due are still uncollectable.
Unlike Chapei and certain extra-Settlement areas directly
affected by active hostilities, the district in question was
only remotely and indirectly affected by warlike operations,
and the remission of two months rent represents a generous
gesture on the part of the landlord; yet, notwithstanding this
special treatment, tenants still persist in their refusal to
pay any rent whatsoever--not even those amounts outstanding
from last year.
It is needless, perhaps, to say that this state of affairs
is most serious indeed, and, if not promptly and effectively
taken in hand, will mean bankruptcy to many landlords. The
urgency of this question is undeniable, and it behooves all
interested to devise ways and means of dealing with this
situation quickly, as the accumulated arrears of rent, if
allowed to continue, will prove a problem difficult to solve.
In this connection, it may be mentioned that although land-
lords have to forego their rent for February and March, their
operating expenses, such as those for water, lighting, etc.,
have to be met in full, which manifestly is far from fair.
At the same time, it might be pointed out to the Association
that illegal tenants' associations are actively agitating for
the forcible reduction of house rents, alleging the present
trade depression as an excuse, without taking into account the
landlords' liabilities and other commitments. It is, of course,
well known that some landlords have built their houses with bor-
rowed capital, and others, although absolute owners of their
property, have not increased their rents for 6 or 7 years, due to
active opposition on the part of the tenants or other reasons,
and any reduction in rent, forcible or otherwise, will mean undue
hardship to them.
It is hoped that the above mentioned, as well as other
kindred questions, are engaging (or have engaged) the attention
of your Committee, and that suitable action will be or have been
taken to effectively counteract the present agitation and attitude
of the tenants' associations.

(SIGNED, JULING VAUGHEN)

副本 1932 年 4 月 18 日

减租煽动活动

谨提请上海房地产主协会主席注意虹口区租户的顽固态度，在那里，尽管已同情性地免除了他们二月和三月的租金，但到期租金仍然无法收取。

与闸北及某些直接受活跃敌对行动影响的租界外地区不同，该区仅间接受到战事行动的轻微影响，免除两个月租金代表了房东的一种慷慨姿态；然而，尽管受到这种特殊对待，租户仍坚持拒绝支付任何租金——甚至包括去年拖欠的金额。

或许无需多说，这种局势确实非常严重，如果不及时有效地加以处理，将意味着许多房东破产。这一问题的紧迫性是不容否认的，所有相关方都有责任迅速想出办法应对这一局面，因为如果允许租金欠款继续累积，将成为一个难以解决的问题。

在此方面，可以提到的是，虽然房东不得不放弃二月和三月的租金，但他们必须全额支付运营费用，如水费、电费等，这显然极不公平。

同时，不妨向协会指出，非法的租户协会正积极煽动强制降低房租，以当前的商业萧条为借口，而不考虑房东的债务和其他承诺。众所周知，有些房东是用借入的资金建造房屋的，而另一些房东虽然是其财产的绝对所有者，但由于租户的激烈反对或其他原因，已有六七年未增加租金，任何强制或其他方式的减租都将给他们带来不当的困难。

希望上述问题以及其他类似问题正在（或已经）引起贵委员会的关注，并且已经（或将要）采取适当行动，以有效抵制当前租户协会的煽动活动和态度。

（签名，JULING VAUGHEN）

16th April, 1932.

A. W. Burk, Esq.,
Secretary,
Shanghai Property Owners' Association,
26, Jinkoo Road.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge the receipt of your letter
of April 16 and of the enclosure sent with it in the matter
of the agitation for rent reduction.

I have to assure you in reply that the movement is
being carefully watched and followed by the Council in con-
junction with the French and Chinese authorities, and the
consequences of such a movement are fully realised. The
exact method of dealing with undesirable manifestations of
the movement is difficult to determine, but the aspect upon
which you lay stress, namely, the possibility of its inducing
to a breach of the peace, is under consideration.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

J. R. JONES
Secretary.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3482.
Date 14 / 4 / 32.

14 APR. 1932

RAVEN TRUST COMPANY

Shanghai, China.
April 13, 1932.

Brig.-Gen. E. B. Macnaghten,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:

If the "Chinese Committee on Rent Reductions
and Exemptions" continues its activities and agitations,
it may become a very disturbing and dangerous element
in the peaceful administration of this city. This com-
mittee for political and selfish reasons, is calling
meetings of Chinese tax payers in the endeavour to incite
tenants to refuse payment of their lawful rents and
taxes. If their efforts succeed, they may and probably
will lead to local or general disturbances or even riots.

This whole movement is certainly against the
peace and good order of the Settlement and I believe
should, if possible, be stopped before it goes too far.

Yours very truly,

(Sgd.) F. J. Raven.

尊敬的先生：

如果“中国减租免税委员会”继续其活动和煽动，它可能成为本市和平行政管理中一个非常令人不安和危险的要素。该委员会出于政治和自私的原因，正在召开中国纳税人会议，企图煽动租户拒绝支付其合法的租金和税款。如果他们的努力成功，可能会并很可能导致局部或普遍的骚乱，甚至暴动。

整个运动肯定违背了租界的和平与良好秩序，我认为如果可能的话，应在其走得太远之前予以制止。

您真诚的，

（签名）F. J. Raven.

April 4, 1932.

Messrs. China Realty Company,
Shanghai.

Dear Sirs,

Our rent of the month of February was
to be paid, as arranged, at the end of March, But on the
30th of March we received a letter from the Shanghai Citizens'
Union and the Committee for the Cancellation and Reduction
of House Rent notifying us not to pay any rent until decisions
are reached by the aforesaid Union and Committee. Inasmuch
as this is the case, despite the fact that we have already
had our money ready for you, we could not pay you right away
at present simply because of the necessity of maintaining
uniformity.

As soon as, however, there are resolutions
reached by the aforesaid Union and Committee, we will imme-
diately see our way to settle all the rent that we owe you.

Trusting that you will see that we are
not intentionally delaying the payment of your rent, we are,
dear Sirs,

Yours very truly,
DIAWARD STEEL FURNITURE CO.

Manager.

TRANSLATION OF A PETITION FROM THE REALTY OWNER'S
ASSOCIATION TO THE MAYOR OF THE MUNI-
CIPALITY OF GREATER SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir,

Ever since the Japanese invasion of Shanghai three
months ago, many houses have been destroyed and blocks of
prosperous districts have been reduced to ashes by Japanese
gun-fires; many people are thus rendered penniless and un-
employed, and a general business depression prevails. These
hard times are shared by all classes of people alike, irres-
pective of their station and means. In business circles,
the questions of unemployment, execution of orders, insurance,
settlement of accounts and mortgages have become difficult
problems as a result of the turmoil. It would be most unfair
to let only a section of the people bear the burden of the
consequences of the war.

Regarding real properties, it is a well known fact
that real estate owners are not all private individuals or
big corporations that hold them with their own surplus or capital.
Some properties are erected on leased lands, some on capital
borrowed from mortgages, and still others are owned by chari-
table and other public institutions which are depending upon
the rentals for their support. It is also a well known fact
that many widows and orphans likewise look upon their rentals
as their only means of subsistance. Superficially, conditions
of real properties look quite prosperous; in reality, they
have been too much exaggerated and, in view of the general
rise of prices and the high rate of taxation, the plight of
pages.zh:
（批：批准）
（批：4月15日收 / 办公室）

大上海特别市市长转房地产主协会请愿书译文。

尊敬的先生：

自三个月前日军入侵上海以来，许多房屋被毁，繁华街区的街区在日军炮火下化为灰烬；许多人因此变得身无分文、失业，商业普遍萧条。这些艰难时世为各阶层人士所共担，无论其地位与财力如何。在商界，由于动荡，失业、订单执行、保险、账目结算及抵押贷款等问题已成为难题。若仅让一部分人承担战争后果的重负，实为极不公平。

关于房地产，众所周知的事实是，房地产所有者并非全是利用自有盈余或资本持有房产的个人或大公司。有些房产建在租赁土地上，有些靠抵押贷款借来的资本建造，还有一些由慈善机构和其他公共机构拥有，这些机构依赖租金维持运作。同样众所周知的是，许多寡妇和孤儿也将租金视为唯一的生计来源。表面上看，房地产状况似乎相当繁荣；实际上，这种情况被过分夸大了，鉴于物价普遍上涨和高税率，业主的困境

pages.en:
- 2 -

of the owners are pretty wretched. Recently, that is, after
the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, the owners
have been confronted with the agitation for rental exemption
and reduction on the part of the tenants. It is true that
some tenants are unable to pay, but the general run makes this
an excellent excuse for evasion of payment. In many cases,
the landlords not only have their properties destroyed by
gun fires without redress, but, their tenants having fled the
war-ridden district, have also to lose the back rents which
may amount to big sums. What is more, the movement has
spread to those districts which were not affected by the war.
If the exemption and reduction of rentals be allowed in these
districts, undue hardships will result and the effects will be
far-reaching indeed. This state of affairs will be naturally
followed by a general delinquency of all payments of interest
and principals of mortgages, cost of materials andlabour,
etc., which will in turn shake the very foundation of the local
money and banking systems.

With a view to maintaining the economic order of the
City and to minimizing the sufferings of realty owners in the
present crisis, we, the Undersigned, have the honour to request
you to do everything within your power to uphold the sanctity
of contracts regarding lahdlords and tenants, and to support
the former's cause in cases that may come up for your
attention.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

十分悲惨。最近，即在中日敌对行动爆发后，业主们面临着租户要求免除和减免租金的鼓动。诚然，有些租户无力支付，但大多数人以此作为逃避支付的绝佳借口。在许多情况下，房东不仅因炮火导致房产受损而无处申诉，而且由于租户逃离战区，还不得不损失可能数额巨大的欠租。更甚者，这一运动已蔓延至未受战争影响的地区。如果允许在这些地区免除和减免租金，将导致不当的困难，其影响确实深远。这种局面自然会导致抵押利息和本金、材料及人工成本等所有款项的普遍拖欠，进而动摇本地货币和银行体系的根基。

为了维护本市的经济秩序，并尽量减少当前危机中房地产主的痛苦，我们以下签署人荣幸地请求您尽一切努力维护有关房东与租户的合同神圣性，并在可能引起您关注的案件中支持前者的诉求。

Representatives of local various public bodies held
a meeting in the Ground Nut Dealers' Association, 101

Citizens' Rent Reduction & Exemption Movement Committee"

landlords to suspend collection of rent in the danger zone
and reduce the rent in other areas. The attendance
advocated that this movement was absolutely necessary in

following resolutions:-

Shanghai General Labour Union.

Workers' Union.

Yui Hwa-loong (余华龙), committee member of the
Citizens' Federation (No.21, Lane 75, Sinza Road)
and a lawyer, 21 Burkill Road.

Chao Tsz-kung (赵子公), committee member of the
Citizens' Federation.

Chang Ih-zung (张一麐), Committee member of the
Citizens' Federation.

Subject (in full)................................ Rent reduction and remission movement.

Made by......... D. S. Tilton .........Forwarded by Thos Robertson Supt.

On May 30, 1932, at 2 p.m., 13 tenants of
houses situated on Ward Road, were summoned at the
Shanghai Special District Court for arrears of rentals
of six to eight months, by the Metropolitan Land Company,
Ltd., 21 Jinkee Road. Two of these tenants paid off
part of the arrears at the Court and arranged to pay
off the arrears by monthly instalments. The remaining
11 tenants intimated their desire to contest the case,
which will be heard on June 4, 2 p.m. The Metropolitan
Land Company are offering two months' rent remission,
on payment of arrears. The legal advisors of the
Metropolitan Land Company are Platt White, Cooper and
Company of 23 Peking Road, whose Chinese agent Tao Kia-
tsung (陶家春), however, did not wish to appear in
the case, which may be attributed to the letters circulated
by the "Managing Committee of the Shanghai Bar Association".
Therefore, Mr. Preston, with his agents Feng and Company,
legal practitioners of 43 Peking Road, were retained.
The estate agents declare that the collection of rentals
is proving very difficult and shows but slight improvement
in response to their continued efforts.
The attitude adopted by the Shanghai Special
District Court in the recent case of Algar and Company
versus tenants which resulted in articles appearing in the
China Times and the posting of notices by the "Shanghai
Citizens' Rent Reduction and Remission Movement Committee"
is expected to greatly influence the refractory tenants.

it would appear that the "Shanghai Citizens' Rent Reduction

主题（全称）................................ 减租免租运动。

FOR TODAY

THE LOCAL COURTS
BY H. G. W. WOODHEAD, LL.B.

THE Chairmen of the British Chamber of Commerce, have these organizations, referred civil cases by the Special District been resented by certain Chinese attempts have been made to rebut them.

A case of the utmost importance to all property owners in Shanghai is now before the First District Court, and in the ordinary course would not be commented upon until a decision had been given. But interference by a self-constituted organization known as the "Shanghai People's Rent Reduction and Exemption Movement Commission" appears to make it doubtful whether a decision in accordance with the law will be obtainable. And the facts are of sufficient interest to justify their narration.

The Dong Tsen Fong Case

THE tenants of a block of buildings situated at the corner of Chekiang and Pakhoi Roads, known as the Don Tsen Fong premises, having refused to pay their rents for January to April (both inclusive) the agents for the property instituted proceedings against them in the First District Court. The date set for the hearing was May 19. The property is owned by the Cathay Land Company, for whom Messrs. Algar and Co. act as agents.

Two days before the hearing the plaintiffs received a letter from the Shanghai People's Rent Reduction and Exemption Movement Commission, quoting at length from communications received from the "Mutual Friendship Association of Dong Tsen Fong Tenants," claiming that the latter's business had been brought to a standstill by the orders issued by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce for a strike, and that the rentals charged were excessive. A demand was made that legal proceedings should be abandoned. In transmitting these communications the Shanghai People's Rent Reduction and Exemption Movement thought fit to write to the plaintiffs as "a warning," demanding the withdrawal of the case, and threatening them with "further opposition from the tenants."

The Hearing

THE hearing nevertheless took place on the date first, and was of several hours duration. Mr. Preston, who appeared for Messrs. Algar & Company with Mr. T. C. Chen, emphasized the importance of the action, which raised the nature of a tenant's rights. He contended that the premises were closed during the whole of February and March by order of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and clients had been unable to carry on business and occupy the premises.

THEN followed a flagrant and apparently successful attempt to interfere with the administration of justice. The Shanghai People's Rent Reduction and Exemption Movement appears to have acquired the co-operation of the local Chinese Bar Association in inducing members of the latter to refuse to appear in rental cases. Anyhow, the Managing Committee circulated at least two letters among the members, having this object in view. And it is understood that several Chinese lawyers have received threatening letters in connection with their appearance in such cases.

Interference, however, was carried very much further than this, if one may credit detailed reports which have appeared in the local Chinese Press. According to an article which was published in the China Press of the 20th inst., representatives of the Shanghai People's Rent Reduction and Exemption Movement went to the First District Court at 10 a.m. the previous day to demand a suspension of judgment in the Dong Tsen Fong case. They were received by the Chief Secretary, who stated that he would convey their statements to the President of the Court. And so, adds the paper, through the delivery of the document by the Dong Tsen Fong tenants, the court was forced to adjourn the hearing.

Actually we have been informed that the case will be restored for the purpose of hearing further evidence.

NOW the Dong Tsen Fong premises are situated in the Central District close to the boundaries of the International Settlement and the French Concession—a locality that at no time during the recent hostilities was endangered. There is every probability that during the crisis the occupants of these premises, like those of others in the same neighbourhood, enjoyed accommodation at relatively high terms in refugee from other areas. In any case it is clear that a demand for the general rental constitutes "oppression" and "exaction," and that measures of social under a new regime are being taken by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. 英国商会主席……这些组织……特别区移交的民事案件……某些中国人的企图已引起不满，并有人试图予以反驳。（注：原文此处语句破碎，似有缺漏或OCR错误，依要求照实译出大意）

一件对所有上海业主都至关重要的案件目前正由第一特区法院审理，按常规程序，在判决作出之前本不予置评。但是，一个自称为“上海市民减租免租运动委员会”的组织进行的干涉，似乎使得依法作出判决变得令人怀疑。鉴于事实本身具有足够的趣味性，值得在此叙述。

东珍丰案（The Dong Tsen Fong Case）

位于浙江路与北海路转角处、被称为“东珍丰”（Don Tsen Fong）的一处建筑群落的租户，因拒绝支付一月至四月（含首尾两月）的租金，该物业代理人遂在第一特区法院对他们提起诉讼。原定开庭日期为5月19日。该物业由国泰地产公司（Cathay Land Company）所有，由阿尔加公司（Messrs. Algar and Co.）担任代理。

在开庭前两天，原告收到来自“上海市民减租免租运动委员会”的一封信，信中大量引用了从“东珍丰租户互助会”收到的函件内容，声称后者的业务因华人总商会发布的罢工命令而陷入停滞，且所收租金过高。信中要求放弃法律诉讼。上海市民减租免租运动委员会在转达这些信函时，认为有必要以“警告”的口吻致信原告，要求撤诉，并威胁称租户将进行“进一步的抵制”。

庭审情况

尽管如此，庭审仍按原定日期进行，持续了数小时。代表阿尔加公司出庭的普雷斯顿先生（Mr. Preston）与陈TC先生（Mr. T. C. Chen）强调了此案的重要性，因为它涉及租户权利的性质问题。他们主张，整个二月和三月期间，根据华人总商会的命令，该物业处于关闭状态，客户无法开展业务，也无法占用该物业。

随后发生了一起公然且看似成功的干扰司法公正的行为。上海市民减租免租运动委员会似乎获得了当地华人律师协会的合作，促使该协会成员拒绝在租金案件中出庭。无论如何，该管理委员会至少在会员中 circulated（传阅/分发）了两封旨在达到此目的的信件。据悉，几位中国律师因在此类案件中出庭而收到了恐吓信。

然而，如果相信当地中文报纸刊登的详细报道，这种干涉行为远不止于此。根据本月20日《字林西报》（China Press）发表的一篇文章，上海市民减租免租运动委员会的代表于前一天上午10点前往第一特区法院，要求暂停对东珍丰案的判决。他们由首席秘书接待，后者表示会将他们的陈述转达给法院院长。该报补充说，因此，通过东珍丰租户递交文件，法院被迫休庭。

实际上，我们获悉该案将恢复审理，以便听取更多证据。

现在，东珍丰物业位于中区，靠近公共租界和法租界的边界——在最近敌对行动期间，该地区从未受到威胁。极有可能在危机期间，这些物业的居住者，如同附近其他物业的居住者一样，以相对较高的条件接纳了来自其他地区的难民。无论如何，显然要求普遍降低租金构成了“压迫”和“勒索”，并且华人总商会正在新政权下采取社会措施。事实上，直到减租组织介入之前，几名租户

TRANSLATION
Of an Extract from the China Times of
the 25th day of May, 1932:

The Shanghai Rent Reduction and Remission Movement Commission
appointed three of its members, Wong Mou Ying, Chang I Tung and Koo Yung
Sung, to make representations to the Court today with reference to the
case in which the Cathay Land Co., Ltd., the Landlords, sued the tenants
of the Dong Chung Fong for rent in arrear.

The following is a full text of a letter from the said Commission
to the Court:-

"We have received a letter from the Mutual Friendship
Association of the Dong Chung Fong Tenants, advising us that
an action had been instituted by the Cathay Land Co., Ltd.
against the tenants for the rent in arrear, and that the Court
had heard the case and decided to announce its judgment on
the 26th instant, and soliciting the assistance of our
Association.

The default of the said tenants to pay the rent for
February and March is really caused by the effects of the war-
fare and the stagnation of the money market; so this case can-
not be comparable with the former ordinary cases for rent in
arrear.

This Association, with a view in fact that the landlords
might mislead the Court under the pretence of claiming rent in
arrear, has written a letter to the Court, requesting that
pending the settlement of the scheme for the rental reduction
and remission the former precedents could not be applied to the
rent incurred during the period of war. This letter must have
received the consideration of the Court.

With reference to the scheme for the rental reduction and
remission, we have repeatedly made representations of our reasons
and have sent to the Court the resolution passed by the General
Meeting of the representatives of the whole City for your considera-
tion.

We have also applied to the Municipality of Greater Shang-
hai to make a promulgation of the scheme at an early date so that
the people can have an uniform action.

It is provided in Article 461 of the Law of Obligation in
Chinese Civil Code that the lessee is not exempted from the duty
to pay rent on the ground that he cannot use the leased object
in part or in full or cannot enjoy profits on account of a cause
for which he is responsible. In other words, it is evident
that if he is not responsible for such cause he is exempted from
the duty to pay the rent, since the war broke out in Shanghai
there was a general agitation throughout the whole City. A
strike had been lasted for two months in the Settlements, and a
reign of terror occasionally prevailed. It is very apparent
that there existed an impossibility to use the leased object and
to enjoy profits therefrom.

上海减租免租运动委员会指派其三名委员，黄慕英（Wong Mou Ying，音译）、张一东（Chang I Tung，音译）和顾永松（Koo Yung Sung，音译），就国泰地产有限公司（Cathay Land Co., Ltd.，房东）起诉东昌坊租户拖欠租金一案，于今日向法院提出交涉。

以下是该委员会致法院函件的全文：——

“我方收到东昌坊租户互助会的来函，告知国泰地产有限公司已因租金拖欠对租户提起诉讼，法院已审理此案并决定于本月26日宣布判决，并请求本会予以协助。

上述租户未支付二月及三月租金，实系受战事影响及金融市场停滞所致；故本案不能与以往普通的欠租案件相提并论。

本会鉴于房东可能以追讨欠租为名误导法院，特致函法院，请求在减租免租方案尚未解决期间，不要将以往的判例适用于战争期间产生的租金。此函想必已得到法院的考量。

关于减租免租方案，我方已反复陈述理由，并将全市代表联席会议通过的决议送呈法院，供贵院审议。

我方亦已向大上海市政府申请，恳请早日公布该方案，以便市民行动统一。

《中华民国民法》债编第461条规定，承租人不得因其可归责之事由，致租赁物一部或全部不能使用或收益，而免除支付租金之义务。换言之，显然若其对该事由不可归责，则免除支付租金之义务。自上海战事爆发以来，全市普遍动荡。公共租界内罢工持续两月之久，恐怖统治亦时有发生。显然，存在无法使用租赁物并从中获益之情形。

Brief Translation

Shanghai, 17th May, 1932.

The Cathay Land Company,
------------
Dear Sirs,
        we have received a letter from the Mutual Friendship
Association of Don Tsen Fong Tenants, which reads :
        "Since the Japanese invasion, misery and devastation
characterize the area affected by the warfare. Even
the Settlement districts adjacent to the war zone
was subject to a state of terror caused by stray
bullets. All communications were stopped and
business declined causing a considerable loss to
the people. The location of the Don Tsen Fong
premises at Chekiang Road, at which our Association
situates, is originally not a good business corner.
The situation has been aggravated by the high rent
fixed by the landlord, the amount of which □□□
more than doubled of that of the property in the
vicinity. The rent becomes so heavy a burden to the
shops that they are compelled to close from time
to time. For example, the real Shanghai Department
Store, one of our members, was compelled to change
ownership several times on account of the high rent.
Since the war broke out, members of our Association
obeyed the notices issued by the Shanghai City
Residents Association and the General Chamber of
Commerce to carry on a strike for as long as two
months. The income thus came to a stop. when
the general situation became better and the shops
were opened again, business appeared to be much
worse than before. Our members thus find great
pages.zh:
简要译文

上海，1932年5月17日。

致国泰地产公司，
------------
敬启者：
        我们收到东新坊租户互助会的来信，内容如下：
        “自日军入侵以来，战区满目疮痍，民不聊生。
即使是毗邻战区的租界地区，也遭受流弹造成的恐怖状态。
所有交通中断，商业衰退，给民众造成巨大损失。
本会所在的浙江路东新坊房屋所在地，原本并非良好的商业地段。
房东制定的高额租金加剧了这一困境，其金额□□□
比附近房产高出一倍多。沉重的租金负担迫使商铺
不时停业。例如，我们的会员之一，真正的上海百货公司，
就因高昂的租金而被迫多次易主。
战争爆发后，本会会员遵照上海市市民协会和总商会的通告，
进行了长达两个月的罢工。收入因此中断。当总体局势好转、
商铺重新开业时，生意似乎比以前更差。因此，我们的会员发现即使

pages.en:
- 2 -

difficulty even in meeting regularly the expenses
of clothing and food. They are limited by their
financial ability to meet such high rent. On the
23rd April, our members received letters from
Mr. Linquan Woo, attorney-at-law, written on behalf
of the Cathay Land Company demanding payment of rent
for January, February, March and April, and threatening
a forcible eviction in case of default. Our
Association, apart from instructing our honorary legal
advisor, Mr. Loh Ching Ying, replied to the said
letters on the 27th, now approach you to assist us
and to uphold justice, so as to hold the high-handed
policy of the landlords in check."

Whilst we are proceeding to examine the case, we have received
another letter from the same Association, which reads :

"Our last letter complaining of the high-handed
policy on the part of the Cathay Land Company
suffered by our members, Yung Kong Hong, Ku Dah
Pharmacy, Chen Yu Hsin Tea Hong, Hwa Song Press Co.,
Mai Dah Hairdressing House, Kwan Chi Hospital, Pei
Hai Tsen, etc., must have been received. The
members of our Association have complied with your
resolution passed at the general meeting to defer
the payment of the rent for the war time pending an
express order and on the 3rd of May, have instructed
our honorary legal advisor, Mr. Loh Ching Ying to
write a letter to the attorney of the landlord
requesting him to collect the rent accrued before
the war time directly from Mr. Loh. On the 9th
of May we received a letter from the landlord's
attorney, Mr. T.C. Chen advising that the landlord
pages.zh:
- 2 -

定期支付衣食费用也极为困难。他们的财力有限，
难以承受如此高昂的租金。4月23日，我们的会员收到
代表国泰地产公司行事的律师吴林泉先生（Linquan Woo）的来信，
要求支付一月、二月、三月和四月的租金，并威胁
若违约将强制驱逐。本会除了指示我们的荣誉法律顾问
罗景英先生（Loh Ching Ying）于27日回复上述信件外，
现特向贵方求助，恳请主持公道，以遏制房东的高压政策。”

在我们着手审查此案之际，又收到该协会的另一封来信，内容如下：

“关于我们会员永公洪、库大药房（Ku Dah Pharmacy）、陈裕新茶庄（Chen Yu Hsin Tea Hong）、华松印刷公司（Hwa Song Press Co.）、美达理发店（Mai Dah Hairdressing House）、关之医院（Kwan Chi Hospital）、北海珍（Pei Hai Tsen）等遭受国泰地产公司高压政策的上一封投诉信，想必已收悉。本会会员已遵守大会通过的决议，暂缓支付战时租金，等待明确指令，并于5月3日指示我们的荣誉法律顾问罗景英先生致函房东的律师，要求其直接向罗先生收取战前积欠的租金。5月9日，我们收到房东律师陈T.C.先生（T.C. Chen）的来信，告知房东

pages.en:
- 3 -

had been informed to collect the rent from Mr. Loh.
To our surprise we received a summons from the
Shanghai No.1 Special District Court on the 10th
asking our members to appear for hearing on the 19th
of May at 2 p.m.. We begin to become aware that
the rent agent of the landlord, the manager of
Algar & Co., Mr. Kent, has instructed the attorney-
at-law, Messrs. A.M. Preston, Linguan woo, T.C.Chen
to institute action in the Court for the rent in
arrear. we therefore write you to solicit your
efforts to maintain justice and to ask the landlord
to sympathize with the difficulties of the merchants
and voluntarily to reduce the amount of the rent.. we
also ask you to request the said attorneys-at-law to
refrain from giving assistance to oppress the merchants.
Besides, may we ask you to instruct your honorary
attorney-at-law to represent us in conjunction with
our Mr. Loh in Court."

This Commission have submitted our scheme for reduction
and exemption of rent basing on the scale designed for
different districts to the government authorities and applied
for promulgation of a public order. Pending the said
publication, the landlords should at least take the general
situation into consideration and hold up any action. On the
contrary, taking advantage of his position, you have instructed
lawyers to take action. The residents, who have suffered
much from the warfare, are now again distressed by the
litigation. Under these circumstances, we, apart from
instructing our lawyer, Mr. Wu Yung Tuch to appear in the
Court, write this to you as a warning and hope you will
withdraw the case and to make a peaceful compromise. We also
request you to refrain from further oppression on the tenants.

Faithfully yours,
The Shanghai Tenants' Rent Reduction &
Exemption Emergency Commission.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

已获知应向罗先生收取租金。令我们惊讶的是，我们在10日收到上海第一特区法院的传票，要求我们的会员于5月19日下午2时出庭受审。我们开始意识到，房东的租金代理人、阿尔加公司经理肯特先生（Mr. Kent）已指示A.M.普雷斯顿、吴林泉、陈T.C.等律师向法院提起诉讼，追讨欠租。因此，我们致函阁下，恳请努力维护正义，并要求房东体谅商人的困难，自愿降低租金数额。我们也请求阁下要求上述律师停止协助压迫商人。此外，能否请阁下指示您的荣誉律师在法庭上与我们的罗先生共同代表我们？”

本委员会已根据为不同区域设计的标准，向政府当局提交了减租和免租方案，并申请颁布公共命令。在该命令公布之前，房东至少应考虑总体局势，暂停任何行动。相反，您却利用自身地位，指示律师采取行动。饱受战火之苦的居民，如今又因诉讼而陷入困境。在此情况下，我们除了指示我们的律师吴永笃先生（Wu Yung Tuch）出庭外，特致此信作为警告，希望您撤回案件并进行和平妥协。我们也请求您停止进一步压迫租户。

此致
敬礼，
上海租户减租免租紧急委员会。

Subject (in full) Action taken at the Shanghai Special District Court
by Algar and Company against tenants for non-
payment of rentals.

Made by D. S. Tilton Forwarded by Thos Robertson Supt.

The case of Algar and Company, Estate Agents,
versus 17 tenants of a block of buildings at the rear
of the Wing On Company, Nanking Road, for non-payment
of rentals was heard at Court No.10, Shanghai Special
District Court at 2 p.m. May 19, 1932, before Judge Loh
Yin. Algar and Company were represented by Mr. Preston
of Ellis and Hayes, and Feng and Company (Woo Ling Kwang and
T.C. Cheng), legal practitioners, 43 Peking Road.

Eleven tenants were represented by Loh Ching
Ying, legal practitioner. During the hearing, the 11
tenants advised by Loh Ching Ying handed into court
payment by cheques to Algar and Company rentals to the
end of January which was accepted, and the case was
continued regarding the rentals for February, March and
April, as claimed by Algar and Company.

Loh Ching Ying claimed the tenants refused pay-
ment for February and March owing to loss of business and
other hardships, and that as the tenants were permitted to
settle three months in arrears the April rentals were not
due to be paid.

Mr. Preston, and Feng and Company claimed that by
sub-leasing the premises the tenants had secured large
profits on the premises, which were situated in a perfectly
safe area and the tenants did not evacuate.

The hearing continued until 6.30 p.m. when the
Judge attempted to bring the parties to a mutual under-
standing to settle the case out of Court, intimating he
would adjourn the proceedings for that purpose. Mr. Preston,
however, declined on behalf of Algar and Company, whereupon

主题（全称）阿尔加公司在上海特区法院针对租户未付租金采取的行动。

由特别情报科督察蒂尔顿（D. S. Tilton）呈报，经警司罗伯逊（Thos Robertson）转呈。

阿尔加公司（房地产代理人）诉南京路永安公司后方一栋建筑的17名租户拖欠租金案，于1932年5月19日下午2时在上海特区法院第10庭，由洛因法官（Judge Loh Yin）审理。阿尔加公司由北京路43号的埃利斯与海斯律师事务所的普雷斯顿先生，以及冯氏律师事务所（吴林广和郑T.C.）的法律从业者代理。

11名租户由法律从业者罗景英代理。在审理过程中，经罗景英建议，这11名租户向法庭提交支票，向阿尔加公司支付截至一月底的租金，该款项被接受，案件继续审理阿尔加公司索赔的二、三、四月租金。

罗景英声称，租户因生意亏损和其他困难拒绝支付二、三月份的租金，并且由于租户被允许结算三个月的欠款，四月份的租金尚未到期支付。

普雷斯顿先生及冯氏律师事务所声称，租户通过转租房屋获得了巨额利润，这些房屋位于完全安全的区域，且租户并未撤离。

REPORT
（印：File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 3482 Date June 17, 19 32. Date 17/6/32）
(in full) Rent Reduction and Remission Movement.
Made by D. S. Tilton Forwarded by Jno Robertson, Supt

The case of the Metropolitan Land Company, Ltd.
versus the 11 tenants for arrears of rentals was heard
at the Shanghai Special District Court at 2 p.m. June 4,
and remanded sine die.
The undersigned interviewed the Acting Chairman
of the General Committee of the Shanghai Property Owners'
Association. Mr. A.M. Preston of Ellis and Hayes,
legal practitioners, 43 Peking Road, from 10.45 a.m.
June 16. He stated that he has already petitioned
the Shanghai Special District Court for the hearing of
the cases of Algar and Company and the Metropolitan
Land Company versus tenants without result. The attitude
of the Court can be only accepted as obvious disinclination
to render a verdict, and by remanding the cases indefinitely
the Court apparently hopes the estate owners and tenants
will arrive at an agreement and thus the Court will avoid
the responsibility of rendering a decision against the
tenants. In the event of the failure of the Court to
pronounce an early date for the hearing of the two cases,
Mr. Preston will forward a letter of complaint to the
Consul General for Great Britain. Mr. Preston added
that the recent action of the Court is forcing the estate
owners to press their tenants for immediate settlement
of arrears and the estate owners are accepting the demands
of the tenants subject to slight modification, as the
financial position of the estate owners will not permit
them to carry on the dispute for an indefinite period.
Therefore, it can be generally accepted that the "Rent
Remission and Reduction Movement" is diminishing.

D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch. Arthur D. Tilton

（全称）减租与免租运动。
由特别情报科督察蒂尔顿（D. S. Tilton）呈报，经警司罗伯逊（Jno Robertson）转呈

大都会地产有限公司（Metropolitan Land Company, Ltd.）诉11名租户拖欠租金案，于6月4日下午2时在上海特区法院审理，并被无限期延期。
具名者于6月16日上午10时45分会见了上海业主协会总委员会代理主席、北京路43号埃利斯与海斯律师事务所的法律从业者A.M.普雷斯顿先生。他表示，他已请求上海特区法院审理阿尔加公司和大都会地产公司诉租户的案件，但未果。法院的态度只能被视为明显不愿作出裁决，并通过无限期延期案件，法院显然希望业主和租户能达成协议，从而避免承担作出对租户不利判决的责任。如果法院未能尽早宣布这两起案件的审理日期，普雷斯顿先生将向英国总领事递交投诉信。普雷斯顿先生补充说，法院最近的举动正迫使业主向租户施压，要求立即结清欠款，而业主们正在接受租户的要求，仅做轻微修改，因为业主的财务状况不允许他们无限期地进行争端。因此，可以普遍认为，“减租免租运动”正在减弱。

D. S.
特别情报科主管。阿瑟·D·蒂尔顿
